senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. קוּף a. נָקַב)to circle; to bore.—Part. pass. נָקוּף; f. נְקוּפָה.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Gen. R. s. 100</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01155"><he>נָקַב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 1:8">Erub. I, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 15b:22">15ᵇ</cite>) <he>והִקִּיפוּהָ</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>כלי בהמה</he> and they surrounded it (the camp) with utensils of travel (wagons, saddles &c.). Ib. 9 <he>מַקִּיפִין שלשה וכ׳</he> you may surround the camp with three ropes &c. (for Sabbath purposes). Ib. 53ᵇ <he>מצאתי שמקיפין אותה גנות וכ׳</he> I found that gardens and orchards surrounded the town (making it inaccessible); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to go around. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 אַקִּיפֵם במדבר וכ׳ I shall make them go around in the desert forty years; ib. הריני מַקִּיפָן וכ׳.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:1">Snh. VIII, 1</cite> <he>עד שיַקִּיף וכ׳</he> until he has grown hair around &c., v. <cite ref="G00642"><he>זָקֵן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to cut all around, esp. (with ref. to Lev. XIX, 27) to cut around the corners of the hair of the head.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 57b:7">Naz. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>אחד המַקִּיף ואחד הנִיקָּף</he> he who cuts and he whose hair is cut are alike guilty; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:16">Ab. III, 16</cite> <he>החנוני מַקִּיף</he> the shopkeeper allows credit (the Lord is long-suffering).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 79a:1">B. Kam. 79ᵃ</cite> top <he>גנב וה׳</he> if he stole an animal and sold it on credit (and has received no pay); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 40a:20">Kidd. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מַקִּיפִין וכ׳</he> no loan on time is granted (no chance for repentance is allowed), when the Name of the Lord is profaned; (oth. interpret., v. <cite ref="N01233"><he>נָקַף</he> I</cite>).

<cite ref="Arakhin 33b">Arakh. 33ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 3b">Meg. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>שה׳ ולבסוף וכ׳</he> it was surrounded (a fort was built) and then settled; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="M00595"><he>מוּקָּף</he></cite>; f. <he>מוּקֶּפֶת</he>; pl. <he>מוּקָּפִין</he>; <he>מוּקָּפוֹת</he>. Ib. I, 1 <he>המ׳ חומה וכ׳</he> fortified since the days of Joshua. Ib. 2ᵇ. Ib. 4ᵇ.
Gen. R. s. 39, v. פָּתִיל; a. fr.—Mekh. B’shall., s. 1 מוקפות semicircular

senses.gloss: to have one’s hair cut all around. Naz. l. c., v. supra. Ib. כל היכא דנ׳ מיחייב וכ׳ whenever he who has his hair cut &c. is punishable (is not a minor or a woman), the cutter is punishable; a. e.
to collect fruit which remained in the crown of the tree (v. נִיקּוּף II), to glean olives (corresp. to פֵּאֵר, Deut. XXIV, 20).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:8">Gitt. V, 8</cite> <he>עני המְנַקֵּף … מה שתחתיו גזל</he> when the poor man does the gleaning on the top of the olive tree, what falls down under him is forbidden to any other person; Y. ed. <he>המנ׳ בראש הזית גזל</he> (corr. acc.; v. ib. 47ᶜ top).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:18">Tosef. ib. XI, 18</cite> <he>מְנַקְּפֵי היגין</he> those who trim shrubs.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:18">Ib.</cite> <he>השוכר … לנַקֵּף עמו וכ׳</he> if one hires a laborer to help him trim &c.
